scope: Read-only correctness review of frozen protocol, training-target identity, delivered data identities/hashes, sufficient statistics, original primary score/LOO/CI, and portable deterministic reproduction. No new sampling, observable, model, fit, tolerance or result selection.

training_target_identity.same_H: On each joint-safe degree class H_s=(n_a*L_s-sum_a L_s)/d; zero outside. Both use physical first/second sources, not half-sum/half-difference coordinates.
training_target_identity.old_expectation: For iid uniform labels U,V, E[(H(U)-H(V))*(Fbar_U-Fbar_V)/2]=E[H F], because E[H]=0. Tail-replica averages do not add a source factor.
training_target_identity.new_expectation: W=sum(max(hnum,0))/d^2=E_uniform[H_+]. Same-class positive/negative coupling gives W*E(Fplus-Fminus)=E[H F]=Delta/(2 epsilon). No further factor 2 is required.
training_target_identity.clock_units: Both use C=(K1+K2)/(2(N+1)), Wclock=(K2-K1)/(N+1). Old New64 integral_A response multiplied by -1/2 is H_C; integral_E response multiplied by -1 is H_W. New tau uses those C/W directly.
training_target_identity.R_units: Both use pi00*(2 Cov(mu_C,H_C)-0.5 Cov(mu_W,H_W)); same coefficients apply to residuals after the frozen predictor. Both numerator and frozen denominator average the two receivers exactly once.
training_target_identity.conclusion: No factor-two, physical-source-coordinate, clock-unit, or population-normalization mismatch found.

independent_primary_reconstruction.method: Recomputed covariance from pooled sufficient SUMS with explicit sample count, then all 60 leave-one-batch subsets. Separately centered all saved prefix mu/tau/prediction arrays and computed the identical original R.

raw_birth_and_census_spotchecks.scope: All census entries and raw baseline/contrast birth-clock rows in these four shards; directly recomputed W, mu_C/W, and tau_C/W without importing frozen scorer.

portable_reproduction.classification: deterministic correctness reproduction only; not a second scientific model selection

limits: These are conditional tests of the frozen fitted coefficients and archive R_old point forecasts. They are not an unconditional old-versus-new population comparison with training uncertainty propagated.
The near-one-half values are descriptive only. Both frozen bands are excluded; this does not establish a one-half law, new physical mechanism, or full contact closure.
